sync.title: Catalog sync
sync.description: Upload the catalog export to update products in bulk. Nothing is written until you review the changes and apply them.
sync.fileHint: Columns: sourceId (required), name, categorySourceId, categoryName, price, stock. Prices are whole numbers in cents; stock is a whole number of pieces and may be negative. A customer tier's price list is its own column, written “price:” plus the tier's sync key — see Customer tiers.
